# Brazier: an iron bowl on a stone pedestal, 0.56 m across, a lime flame (an unlit cone round a bright
# tongue that rises out of it) and its stippled pool of light on the floor (textures/halo.png, alpha-
# masked, unlit); blocks its tile. Origin: on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Base --base-color 0.3059 0.2941 0.3529 --no-slot
material new Iron --base-color 0.1451 0.1647 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Flame --base-color 0.5098 0.6510 0.2549 --no-slot
material new Core --base-color 0.7098 0.8588 0.4000 --no-slot
material new Pool --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Pool base-color textures/halo.png
material set Pool alpha-mode mask
material set Pool alpha-cutoff 0.5
add mesh cone --name Base --vertices 8 --radius1 0.26 --radius2 0.16 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
material assign Base
add mesh cone --name Bowl --vertices 8 --radius1 0.14 --radius2 0.3 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0.6
material assign Iron
add mesh cone --name F0 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.24 --radius2 0.1 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0.8
material assign Flame
add mesh cone --name F1 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.42 --location 0.02 -0.03 1.0
material assign Core
add mesh circle --name Pool --vertices 16 --radius 1.4 --cap-fill ngon --location 0 0 0.025
material assign Pool
active Pool
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
select all
shade flat
export brazier.glb
